name: Argentiferous-Vanguard
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a tidally locked hemisphere, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.

The terrain around the escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on fusion fuel, water and biomass are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
